# Risky paths: a change to any file matching one of these globs goes through
# the gauntlet (.github/workflows/gauntlet.yml, explained in docs/GAUNTLET.md).
#
# One glob per line, relative to the repo root. `*` matches within one folder,
# `**` matches any number of folders. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
# A `## ` line starts an area; the gauntlet's summary names the area each
# changed file falls in. Keep the list grounded in code that can lose files,
# break data or open a hole, not in whole packages for convenience.

## Deletes or moves files
# Moving the music to another drive: copy, check, switch, remove the old copies
core/drives/**
api/drives.py
# The repair worker and its jobs (retag, rename, convert, delete fakes)
core/repair_worker.py

# Export to Traktor: writes .nml files into a configured export folder, and
# the DJ routes that save its settings and serve the export
core/dj/traktor.py
api/dj.py
# Library → Sets: the routes (per-profile sets, body caps, pasted text, the
# delete) and all of core/sets (the store that deletes a set's rows, the
# tracklist reader that parses other sites' text, matching, Wanted writes,
# and the sources below)
api/sets.py
core/sets/**
# Stars: per-profile rows (one profile never reads or changes another's),
# the library-scope check on what can be starred, and the body caps
api/stars.py
core/stars/**
# The Mix tab: its ranking reads the caller's stars, sets and listening
# history (and the library store's scoped queries it builds on); Vibe sends
# track details to the AI provider and counts the profile's usage. The
# working set and "Add" after the playing track are in core/sets/** above
core/dj/ranking.py
core/dj/vibe.py
core/dj/store.py
# Auto-mix stage A: each track's beat grid, phrases and sections (the
# analysis decodes library files in the background sweep, the store's reads
# are scoped to the caller's library, and the planner feeds the grid and plan
# routes in api/dj.py above)
core/dj/grid.py
core/dj/grid_store.py
core/dj/planner.py
# The tempo's octave (drum and bass at 174, not 87): the rule the sweep's
# analysis and the grid run on every library file (it reads each file's genre
# tag); a person's Double / Halve BPM is in api/dj.py and core/dj/store.py above
core/sample/tempo.py
# Auto-mix stage B: the window route's decoder (runs ffmpeg on a library
# file for a caller, with caps on length, end and how many at once; the route
# and its scope check are in api/dj.py above, the kids guard in
# api/content_guard.py below)
core/dj/window.py
# Analyse on demand: any profile puts its own library's tracks first in the
# DJ sweep (per-profile caps and a rate limit, scoped to the caller's
# library), the sweep's waits and Stop for that line, and the progress route
# that names only the caller's own tracks
core/dj/ondemand.py
core/dj/progress.py
core/dj/worker.py
